name: Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime-Plus
access: QwenCloud realtime API (WebSocket; AOQ and WebRTC also listed), Singapore-region API key

voice.input_audio: PCM 16-bit mono at 16 kHz (pcm is the only format); about 100 ms per chunk (3,200 bytes) is advised [qwencloud-audio-events] [qwencloud-audio-guide]
voice.output_audio: PCM 16-bit mono at 24 kHz (pcm is the only format) [qwencloud-audio-events] [qwencloud-audio-guide]
voice.voices: 5 system voices (default longanqian) and cloned voices made with the voice-cloning API; the voice can be set only in the first session.update [qwencloud-audio-guide]
languages: Conversation: German, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese, with 21 Chinese varieties
voice.turn_detection: server_vad (default; threshold default 0.5; silence_duration_ms 200 to 6000, default 800), smart_turn (acoustic and semantic), or null for push-to-talk; the mode can be set only before the first audio is sent [qwencloud-audio-ws] [qwencloud-audio-events]
voice.interruption: In server_vad and smart_turn modes new user speech cancels the running response (response.done with status cancelled); the client should clear its playback buffer on input_audio_buffer.speech_started; in smart_turn mode fillers do not interrupt playback [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-audio-ws]
voice.latency: Artificial Analysis: average time to first audio 1.54 seconds on its Big Bench Audio set [aa-s2s]
voice.session_limit: Not stated for this API; context of 65K tokens, and the model keeps at most 50 audio turns or 300 seconds of audio (default 20 turns) [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-page-audio30plus]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: QwenCloud model page (read 2026-10-03), per million tokens: audio input US$6.4 (the input field); text input US$0.8; text output US$6.4; text and audio output US$24 (the output field; output text is then not charged). Artificial Analysis lists US$0.03 per hour of input audio and US$0.18 per hour of output audio, which does not match the page rates [qwencloud-page-audio30plus] [aa-s2s]
